profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Freedom
profile.summary: Software developer and communication systems engineer with 10+ years experience working in a multi-disciplinary environment. Extensive background in digital signal processing (DSP), digital communications, software-defined radio (SDR), and wireless standards. Strong knowledge of Python and C++. Enjoys keeping up with the latest technologies and envisioning ways to apply them to projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building a software platform called Freedom (https://freedom.to) to reduce digital distractions and help people become more productive

• Create and manage development of end-user applications for iOS, Mac OS X (Objective-C & Swift), and Windows (C#)
• Make decisions on which 3rd-party libraries to use
• Design user interfaces for applications
• Handle Apple App Store releases for iOS client and manage keywords
• Manage deployment of desktop client updates to Amazon S3
• Maintain HTTP/HTTPS proxy program written in Go
• Implemented in-app VPN for iOS application
• Work with REST API and provide suggestions for new endpoints
• Test applications on various operating systems and versions
• Code review pull requests in GitHub
• Research various methods for blocking websites and ports
• Handle customer service requests via email and phone and provide high-end support for complex issues
• Write help documentation for support site
• Help develop company roadmap

positions.title: Signal and Image Processing Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead Software Developer on several projects, defined overall code structure, delegated tasks, reviewed code, maintained Git code repositories
• Developed coding standards for C++ and Python for various projects
• Refactored major component of a C++/Python/X-Midas based processing suite to enable integration into the REDHAWK SDR framework
• Increased speed of software-based Viterbi and Turbo decoders by 10x using SIMD and multi-threaded programming (OpenMP) techniques for supporting real-time processing of signals
• Administrator for several Linux systems, provided software installation support, and managed user accounts and system resources
• Technical adviser for various projects and proposals involving wireless technologies

positions.title: Communications Systems Engineer
positions.description:
• Created a signal generator for simulating 802.11a/g signals in C++ and Python
• Researched and developed smart jamming techniques for WiMAX signals
• Implemented a flexible soft-decision Viterbi decoder in C++ for decoding convolutional codes utilizing tail-biting and convolutional turbo codes
• Mentored summer interns by providing guidance on various projects assigned to them
• Experienced with Agilent signal generator and signal analyzer hardware for working with and generating Wi-Fi and WiMAX signals
• Trained new hires on concepts of signal processing, programming, and communications
• Recruited on-campus at several universities, held technical interviews, and served as a point-of-contact for several candidates before and after on-site interviews

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Wrote software in MATLAB to process data collected for ultrasonic measurement lab
• Assisted with collecting data using load machine

positions.title: Lead Teaching Assistant  - Digital Design Lab
Communications Systems Intern
positions.description:
• Developed software framework for transmitting OFDM signals in X-Midas
• Designed system to disrupt 802.11a/g wireless signals
• Converted software from Fortran to C++ and wrote a Fortran to C++ conversion guide
• Designed GUI front end for installation scripts using Qt
• Provided help to other developers for installing Linux and X-Midas
